tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Why did you get so wet?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: If I had taken an umbrella, I would have stayed dry.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Why didn't you come to the party?"

B builds the answer from the tiles. All the verbs are in the base form. For the past, use if + had + past participle, then would have + past participle. After wish, use the past simple (now) or had + past participle (the past).
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: If I had …, I would have …

tandemRedemittel.p1: Is that a regret about now or about the past?
tandemRedemittel.p2: The past: wish + had + past participle.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?

tandemFragen.frage: Why didn't you come to the party?
tandemFragen.antwort: If I had known, I would have come.

tandemFragen.frage: Why did Tom miss the train?
tandemFragen.antwort: If he had left earlier, he would have caught it.

tandemFragen.frage: Are you happy with your flat?
tandemFragen.antwort: No, I wish I had a bigger kitchen.

tandemFragen.frage: How was your holiday in Spain?
tandemFragen.antwort: I wish we had booked a hotel near the beach.

tandemFragen.frage: Why didn't Amira pass her driving test?
tandemFragen.antwort: If she had practised more, she would have passed.

tandemFragen.frage: Why are you so tired today?
tandemFragen.antwort: I wish I had gone to bed earlier.

tandemFragen.frage: Do you like living in the city?
tandemFragen.antwort: No, I wish I lived in the countryside.

tandemFragen.frage: Why did the company lose the contract?
tandemFragen.antwort: If they had replied sooner, they would have kept it.

tandemFragen.frage: Why didn't Priya take the job in Leeds?
tandemFragen.antwort: If the salary had been higher, she would have taken it.

tandemFragen.frage: How does Liam feel about selling his car?
tandemFragen.antwort: He wishes he hadn't sold it.
